purpose: Describe the long-term institutional financial relationship architecture around the Sponsor family, Aweswell Limited, Sun Rock and independently underwritten hotel ProjectCos without publishing private family balance-sheet data or implying committed financing.

brand_architecture.family_layer: Sponsor family / private wealth — detailed balance sheet remains restricted and is not stated on the public website
brand_architecture.sun_rock_legal_status: Commercial hospitality and investment group/platform identity; not represented as a separate incorporated parent company or automatic borrower
brand_architecture.project_sun_rock_public_programme: Public programme/site umbrella; not an asset owner, borrower, fund or securities issuer
brand_architecture.operating_layer: Separately underwritten hotel and operating assets
brand_architecture.liquidity_loop: Refinancing, distributions and realised liquidity may support private wealth and recycled Sponsor capital without automatic cross-collateralisation

current_legitimate_work: Relationship onboarding, governance and KYC/AML preparation
Restricted family financial map and liquidity planning
Montaña Roja transaction and capital-structure preparation
Identification of debt, equity, preferred and co-investment routes without representing commitment
possible_3_to_10_year_relationship: Acquisition and development financing for independently underwritten hotels
Private wealth custody and investment of realised distributions or other lawful liquidity
Capital recycling into later hospitality opportunities

platform_scale_reference.headline: A EUR 150m-class hospitality platform in the making

project_finance_rules: Each ProjectCo should be independently governed and underwritten.
Avoid unnecessary cross-collateralisation that could impair future ProjectCo bankability.
One institutional relationship does not imply that every desk, fund or capital pool will invest.
Future platform scale is context and is not present collateral.
No unresolved recovery or damages claim is ordinary project debt-service support or present collateral.

recovery_boundary.rule: Only realised or sufficiently recognised recoveries should later strengthen cash, recognised net assets, debt repayment capacity, Sponsor capital or investable family liquidity.

publication_rules: Do not name banks or investors as counterparties unless a separately verified public mandate or commitment exists.
Do not represent Montaña Roja as acquired, approved or financed before those events occur.
Do not represent Sun Park / MYND Yaiza operating accounts or cash flow as presently controlled by Sun Rock.
Do not present illustrative platform-scale numbers as current NAV, audited accounts, forecast, collateral or financing commitment.
Keep detailed family balance-sheet and liquidity information restricted and outside the public repository.
terminology_rule: Institutional relationship may be coordinated at group level, but legal obligations, credit, security and cash flows remain attached to the relevant Aweswell or ProjectCo entity.
